name: skill-authoring
description: Skill authoring for any repository: design and write skills, review them with independent agents, and audit which skills to create, update, merge, or skip.

interface.longDescription: Use Skill Authoring to carry a skill change from spec to release, design and write one skill with its skill spec, review it with independent agents, and audit which skills a repository should create, update, merge, or skip.
defaultPrompt: Use skill-orchestrator to carry this skill change from spec to release.
Use skill-creation to design or update one named skill.
Use skill-review to independently review this skill.
Use skill-audit to audit these skills against session evidence.
